{{Quote|Do I get to know what's going on?''"<br />"''Sure. We've got pirates on the way.''"<br />"''Pirates? Here?''"<br />"''Sure. Why not?|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Specter" />}}
The '''Raid at Iphigin''' was an attack of the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] against the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of [[Iphigin]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|What's this all about?''"<br />"''What's it always about at this end of the Core. The Diamala and Ishori are at it again.''"<br />"''Let me guess. Commerce and resource-sharing dispute?|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Specter" />}}
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Iphigin was the site of a conference organized by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], [[Ponc Gavrisom]], to solve an [[Ishori]]&ndash;[[Diamal]] dispute. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were present to conduct the negotiations when the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] arrived in the system.

This raid was part of the large [[Sinister Triumvirate|destabilization campaign]] launched by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra]] against the New Republic. The [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] played a large role in his plan. He provided them with information, and the last of [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] while they attacked the New Republic ships.

==The raid==
{{Quote|It's an old trick: you call an alert on some ship coming in sun-side, then hit a nightside target while Customs is busy half a planet away.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Specter" />}}
The attack began when the pirates sent a suspect [[Sarkan/Legends|Sarkan]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] in the sun-side of the planet, calling a [[Iphigini]] Customs red alert. Han Solo guessed it was a diversion and decided to intervene. As expected, a pirate fleet arrived soon after in the nightside and attacked two New Republic transports. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] and Luke's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] immediately engaged them. While Luke attacked the [[Corsair-class cruiser|''Corsair'' fighters]], Han and Chewbacca destroyed the powerful [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|KDY]] [[a-4 ion cannon]] of a old [[Kaloth-style battlecruiser|''Kaloth'' cruiser]]. After Skywalker had managed to destroy all the fighters, the remaining pirates forces escaped in [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. One of the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|Corellian Gunships]] was considerably damaged by the two armed transports.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|We are the Imperial Fleet. We do not hire mercenaries and pirate gangs from the fringe to fight our battles for us.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]] to [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra]]|<ref name="Specter" />}}
During the battle, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] was profoundly affected when he felt the pirate crews were made of clones. He decided to investigate more about this. Han Solo later requested [[Talon Karrde]] to assist the Jedi in his search. Karrde sent [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] to help Skywalker in his [[Mission to the Kauron asteroid field|infiltration]] of the [[Cavrilhu's Kauron base|Cavrilhu base]] in the [[Kauron asteroid field]].

Meanwhile, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] ordered [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dreyf]] an investigation to find possible relationships between pirates and high ranking [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]].
